killedBy: the versus map cards (issue #274) tells Random how many boards it will draw from, counting the row and not the catalog
why: Random counts ITSELF among the boards it will draw from -- the off-by-one available at this exact line, since `choices` is the eligible boards plus Random and the `- 1` is the only thing separating them. The card then claims seven boards where six are offered, which is issue #274's "Random never selects outside the displayed eligible set" broken as a STATEMENT rather than as behaviour: `pickVersusArena` still draws correctly from `versusMapChoices`, so nothing about the match is wrong and nothing else in the suite can see it. Spelled as this slip rather than as `VERSUS_CATALOG.length`, which hud.ts does not import and would therefore be killed by a ReferenceError -- a crash proves nothing about the assertion. Note what this entry cannot prove: every shipped (players, mode) combination yields exactly six eligible boards, so a hardcoded `6` would survive it; the case that kills this pins that population so the day a catalog edit breaks the tie it asks for a better fixture rather than staying quietly vacuous.
